changeSet.sql: UPDATE closedcash SET datestart = strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', CAST(datestart AS REAL) / 1000.0, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') WHERE (typeof(datestart) IN ('integer', 'real') OR (typeof(datestart) = 'text' AND length(datestart) BETWEEN 1 AND 14 AND datestart NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')) AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', CAST(datestart AS REAL) / 1000.0, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') IS NOT NULL;
